title: crataegus austera
intro: Crataegus austera, commonly known as the Himalayan hawthorn, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat cardiovascular diseases, with its reported health benefits including lowering blood pressure, improving lipid profiles, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of C. austera are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardio-protective properties, which are believed to be the result of its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of C. austera as a medicinal plant.
